details:
Software Engineer -
Sydney or Melbourne | Hybrid | 6 month initial contract
Build the Future of Energy, One Line of Code at a Time.
A rapidly scaling energy tech company is transforming how distributed energy systems are orchestrated at scale, in real time, and across borders. As a Software Engineer, you’ll engineer high-impact cloud applications that drive the energy transition.
What You’ll Be Doing:
Building Python applications in complex, event-driven AWS environments. FastAPI experience would be ideal
Working across Lambda, Fargate, SQS/SNS, and Postgres-backed microservices
Designing for scale: multi-region, multi-tenant cloud architecture
Owning end-to-end development from design to deployment and monitoring
Shaping systems that support virtual power plant operations and analytics
What’s On Offer:
Long term programme of work with attractive days rates
Opportunity to contribute to a global positive cause
About You:
Experienced in AWS-native systems, event-driven architecture, and Python
Confident working with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines
Comfortable leading full lifecycle development and collaborating cross-functionally
A clear communicator, critical thinker, and natural problem-solver
Background in energy or fintech? Even better
